stage.note: Only one priced round is on record (Aug 2021, right after the YC S21 batch). Crunchbase's financial_details page also labels it Pre-Seed; aggregator startupintros.com instead labels the same round 'Seed' ($2M). No later round (Series A etc.) has been reported as of 2026-09-30; getlatka quotes the CEO describing the company as largely bootstrapped/self-funded since.

revenue.quote: WarpBuild 2024 estimated revenue: $1M ARR. 7 employees. Founded 2021.

note: WarpBuild (Surya Oruganti, YC S21) provides fast GitHub Actions CI runners (Linux/macOS/Windows, x86-64 and arm64) plus newer AI-agent-runner and Helios workflow products. Only one small priced round is publicly documented (~2021, disclosed as Pre-Seed by Crunchbase/CB Insights but as a $2M 'Seed' by other aggregators); no primary press release or company statement confirming the amount was found, and no subsequent round has been reported through 2026. Getlatka quotes the CEO saying the company grew to ~$1M ARR largely on its own revenue rather than follow-on VC funding.
